title: Effect of Retrograde Autologous Blood Priming on Pulmonary Mechanics in Pediatric Cardiac Surgery
brief_summary: The present study hypothesized that beyond its hemodynamic affects,retrograde autologus blood priming of cardiopulmonary bypass (RAP) has a positive impact on hemodynamics and pulmonary mechanics subjected to cardiac surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* children complained of congenital heart disease with left to right shunt pressure or volume load

Exclusion Criteria:

* cyanotic heart disease
